newsitem.title: USA: USDA adds $5 mln to El Salvador PL 480 pact.
newsitem.headline: USDA adds $5 mln to El Salvador PL 480 pact.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Tuesday said amended the fiscal year 1996 Title I, Public Law 480 sales pact with El Salvador to add $5 million for the purchase of tallow and soybean meal.
USDA said the El Salvador may buy about 5,500 tonnes or $2.5 million worth of tallow and about 9,000 tonnes or $2.5 million worth of soybean meal.
The supply period is fiscal year 1996.
USDA said the action brings El Salvador's fiscal 1996 agreement to $15 million.
